actions.title: Read the override evidence boundary
actions.instruction: U02 records one deliberately scoped training override, then binds local audit and metric evidence to that record. An override is exceptional and narrow. Do not use this lesson to bypass a security-critical, secret, crypto, destructive, or irreversible stop.
actions.rationale: An audit trail is useful only when it stays separate from the decision it records.
actions.expected_result: You know that the exercise concerns one safe-training-gate entry and locally derived evidence only.
actions.recovery: If the requested bypass is security-critical or irreversible, stop this lesson instead of recording an override.
actions.evidence: Check can bind changed local files and values. It does not prove human approval, that a host command ran, or any hosted fact.

actions.title: Prepare a numbered U02 attempt
actions.instruction: At the clean Academy clone root, use a native terminal to prepare U02. Native-terminal commands go directly into that terminal and never begin with !.
actions.rationale: Prepare gives this exercise its own numbered attempt and scenario before any override evidence exists.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.14 refuses U02 as unavailable or not published and leaves the repository unchanged.
actions.recovery: Treat the refusal as the current public boundary. Do not retry with another command, edit local state, or simulate an attempt.
actions.evidence: A future private release may prepare an attempt. The current Preview 0.14 command does not create one.

actions.title: Confirm the refusal left no attempt
actions.instruction: After the current Preview 0.14 refusal, inspect the worktree in a native terminal. These are direct terminal commands and never begin with !.
actions.rationale: The learner must distinguish an unavailable lesson from a prepared local starting condition.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.14 has refused U02 and the worktree remains unchanged.
actions.recovery: If the worktree changed, investigate that unrelated state separately. Do not create a U02 scenario file by hand.
actions.evidence: No current public U02 scenario is prepared. A future private scenario would still describe local input, not a hosted state.

actions.title: Decide whether the scoped training override is appropriate
actions.instruction: In a future private prepared attempt, decide for yourself whether the safe-training-gate exercise justifies one narrow override. Name the gate and reason before asking the host to record it. A log entry is not a substitute for your decision. Do not run this future-only step in Preview 0.14.
actions.rationale: The record should follow a specific scope decision, never manufacture one.
actions.expected_result: For a future private attempt, you have either stopped because the scope is unsafe or can state one limited training reason.
actions.recovery: If you cannot name a specific safe reason, do not invoke an override command. Reset the attempt or seek the appropriate governed lane.
actions.evidence: No generated file can authenticate the learner's reasoning or approval.

actions.title: Record one scoped override through CodeArbiter
actions.instruction: Only in a future private prepared attempt and after your own scope decision, invoke the host-native override command. It is a CodeArbiter command, never a ! terminal passthrough command. Do not invoke it from Preview 0.14 U02 refusal flow.
actions.rationale: The governed command records the operator identity, gate, and reason in the append-only local log.
actions.expected_result: In a future private attempt, one new append-only override line names the local training gate and reason.
actions.recovery: If the host asks for missing identity or rejects the reason, supply only the requested local detail or stop. Do not edit prior log entries.
actions.evidence: The line can show recorded text; it cannot prove who made a decision outside the repository.

actions.title: Inspect the new record through the selected harness shell
actions.instruction: In a future private prepared attempt, use the selected harness shell to inspect the local log. Harness shell commands begin with exactly one ! and are not CodeArbiter commands.
actions.rationale: This makes the shell boundary visible while keeping the recorded line separate from the host command that created it.
actions.expected_result: You can identify the new local line without changing it.
actions.recovery: If the line is absent or malformed, stop and reset the attempt. Do not hand-edit overrides.log to imitate a host action.
actions.evidence: Inspection shows current local text only; it does not prove the command chronology.

actions.title: Assemble a read-only governance audit
actions.instruction: In a future private prepared attempt, invoke the host-native audit command for the prepared range. It is a CodeArbiter command and never a ! terminal passthrough command.
actions.rationale: The audit packet supplies a local, read-only source for reviewing the recorded override.
actions.expected_result: A dated local audit packet identifies the resolved range and the one recorded override line. Keep its printed path for the later staging boundary.
actions.recovery: If the command cannot resolve a range, preserve its message and provide an explicit local range only if the host requests one.
actions.evidence: The packet is local evidence; it does not attest to external hosting or approval.

actions.title: Read the governance metric glance
actions.instruction: In a future private prepared attempt, invoke the host-native metrics command. It is a read-only CodeArbiter command and never a ! terminal passthrough command.
actions.rationale: Metrics summarize local governance trends without replacing the audit record.
actions.expected_result: You see the three local metric values and their window.
actions.recovery: If the helper fails, preserve its error and stop rather than inventing metric values.
actions.evidence: The glance is read-only and cannot prove that any value reflects a hosted service.

actions.title: Keep the metrics glance out of committed evidence
actions.instruction: Only in a future private prepared attempt, do not create an Academy audit receipt, metrics receipt, transcript, or JSON summary. $ca-audit already wrote the durable packet; $ca-metrics is a read-only terminal glance. Do not stage, commit, or push.
actions.rationale: A committed learner-written summary would falsely look like proof of an advisory command that writes nothing.
actions.expected_result: The only durable evidence remains the actual override log and the actual audit packet; the metrics glance is not committed.
actions.recovery: If a draft receipt already exists, remove only that untracked draft before staging. Do not alter the override log or audit packet to imitate command output.
actions.evidence: Check validates repository artifacts, not a transcript, human approval, or invocation of the read-only metrics command.

actions.title: Review the exact drafted evidence boundary
actions.instruction: In a future private prepared attempt, inspect the two-path evidence boundary: .codearbiter/overrides.log and the exact dated .codearbiter/audits packet printed by the audit command. Confirm the packet quotes the one new override line and neither file makes an approval or hosted-service claim. Do not stage, commit, or push.
actions.rationale: The learner reviews only real CodeArbiter artifacts before committing them.
actions.expected_result: You can accept the narrow two-path evidence boundary or identify the exact artifact that needs correction.
actions.recovery: If an artifact is invented, stale, or outside the two-path boundary, remove only the untracked invention and review again. Historical audit packets may remain; do not substitute one for the exact path printed by this attempt's audit command.
actions.evidence: Review remains a learner action; no artifact can prove that it occurred.

actions.title: Stage only the U02 evidence boundary
actions.instruction: Only after the learner accepts the future private real-artifact boundary, stage the override log and the exact path printed by the audit command for its dated packet in a native terminal. Paste that exact path when the command prompts; do not search .codearbiter/audits or choose among historical packets. Native-terminal commands never begin with !.
actions.rationale: A two-file staged boundary retains the real audit-command output without fabricating an Academy receipt.

variants.command:
$auditPacket = Read-Host "Paste the exact audit packet path printed by the earlier audit command"
if ($auditPacket -notmatch '^\.codearbiter/audits/.+\.md$' -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $auditPacket -PathType Leaf)) { throw "The pasted audit packet path is not the dated packet printed by the audit command." }
git add -- .codearbiter/overrides.log $auditPacket
git diff --cached --name-only

printf '%s\n' 'Paste the exact audit packet path printed by the earlier audit command:' >&2
IFS= read -r audit_packet
case "$audit_packet" in .codearbiter/audits/*.md) ;; *) echo "The pasted audit packet path is not the dated packet printed by the audit command." >&2; exit 1;; esac
[ -f "$audit_packet" ] || { echo "The pasted audit packet path is not the dated packet printed by the audit command." >&2; exit 1; }
git add -- .codearbiter/overrides.log "$audit_packet"
git diff --cached --name-only

printf '%s\n' 'Paste the exact audit packet path printed by the earlier audit command:' >&2
IFS= read -r audit_packet
case "$audit_packet" in .codearbiter/audits/*.md) ;; *) echo "The pasted audit packet path is not the dated packet printed by the audit command." >&2; exit 1;; esac
[ -f "$audit_packet" ] || { echo "The pasted audit packet path is not the dated packet printed by the audit command." >&2; exit 1; }
git add -- .codearbiter/overrides.log "$audit_packet"
git diff --cached --name-only

actions.expected_result: Exactly two paths are staged: the override log and the exact dated audit packet.
actions.recovery: If the printed audit packet path is absent or another path is staged, unstage only the unexpected path and inspect again. Do not reset or rewrite the attempt history.
actions.evidence: The staged diff is a local scope check, not evidence of a human review.

actions.title: Commit the local evidence through CodeArbiter
actions.instruction: After you review the staged boundary, invoke the host-native commit gate. It is a CodeArbiter command and never a ! terminal passthrough command.
actions.rationale: The final commit lets Check compare the changed local evidence with the prepared attempt.
actions.expected_result: The attempt gains a commit containing the scoped U02 evidence.
actions.recovery: If the gate blocks, preserve the finding and correct only the named evidence boundary. Do not amend or rewrite the attempt.
actions.evidence: A commit proves changed repository paths and bytes, not a human approval or host conversation.

actions.title: Run the local U02 checkpoint
actions.instruction: Run Check in a native terminal. Native-terminal commands never begin with !.
actions.rationale: Check validates the prepared-attempt delta and deterministic local evidence contract.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.14 refuses U02 as unavailable or not published and leaves the repository unchanged.
actions.recovery: Treat the refusal as the current public boundary. A future private Check may validate named local evidence, but do not invent a current pass.
actions.evidence: The current public command does not report a U02 pass. A future private result would still not confirm a hosted fact or authenticate human approval.

actions.title: Reset this attempt safely
actions.instruction: If the attempt cannot be corrected within its evidence boundary, use Academy Reset in a native terminal. Native-terminal commands never begin with !.
actions.rationale: Reset preserves the earlier attempt rather than hiding an invalid override record through history rewriting.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.14 refuses U02 as unavailable or not published and leaves the repository unchanged.
actions.recovery: Treat the refusal as the current public boundary. Do not use destructive Git commands to imitate a reset or erase unrelated state.
actions.evidence: A future private Reset may preserve attempt history; the current public command creates no U02 archive.
